t: You're standing in Poets' Corner, in the south transept of Westminster Abbey, where many poets, playwrights and writers are buried or commemorated. Among those buried here are the Victorian poet Robert Browning, known for his dramatic monologues, and John Masefield, Poet Laureate from 1930 until his death in 1967, who wrote Sea-Fever. The actor David Garrick lies here, and so does his wife, the dancer Eva Marie Veigel. The composer George Frideric Handel is buried here too, as is the television host Sir David Frost.
